LineageStatement:
[Columns]:   
    SELECT
    // Keys
        CONCAT('AZDB-AUE-PRD-NIAADL01', '|', c.object_id)                        AS [Object Key],
        CONCAT('AZDB-AUE-PRD-NIAADL01', '|', c.column_id)                        AS [Column Key],
        CONCAT('AZDB-AUE-PRD-NIAADL01', '|', c.object_id, '|', c.column_id)      AS [Table Key Assoc Key],
        CONCAT('AZDB-AUE-PRD-NIAADL01', '|', c.user_type_id)                     AS [User Type Key],

    // Attributes
        c.name                                                        AS [Column Name],
        CASE WHEN c.is_nullable = 0 THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END             AS [Nullable],
        c.max_length                                                  AS [Column Max Length],
        c.precision                                                   AS [Column Precision],

    // Extended property (column description), nullable
    	CAST(ep.value AS NVARCHAR(4000))                              AS [Column Description]
	
	FROM "AZDB-AUE-PRD-NIAADL01".sys.all_columns AS c WITH (NOLOCK)
	LEFT JOIN "AZDB-AUE-PRD-NIAADL01".sys.extended_properties AS ep WITH (NOLOCK)
         ON ep.major_id = c.object_id
        AND ep.minor_id = c.column_id         // minor_id <> 0 means column-level EPs
        AND ep.name     = N'MS_Description'
